entries.text: 洛托洛托洛托洛托……
entries.label: team_0090_system_01

entries.text: 你好像从皮拿那里得到了\n老大之证团队徽章啊。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_02a

entries.text: 你好像从秋明那里得到了\n老大之证团队徽章啊。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_02b

entries.text: 你好像从奥尔迪加那里得到了\n老大之证团队徽章啊。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_02c

entries.text: 你好像从梅洛可那里得到了\n老大之证团队徽章啊。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_02d

entries.text: 你好像从枇琶那里得到了\n老大之证团队徽章啊。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_02e

entries.text: 这样一来，失去老大的\n阁道二小队就濒临崩溃了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_04a

entries.text: 这样一来，失去老大的\n策星小队会溃不成军了吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_04b

entries.text: 这样一来，失去老大的\n阁道三小队就要完蛋了啊。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_04c

entries.text: 这样一来，失去老大的\n王良四小队应该就会消失了……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_04d

entries.text: 这样一来，失去老大的\n王良一小队离解散不远了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_04e

entries.text: 终于只剩最后１个老大了……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_07

entries.text: 作战进行得如此顺利，\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，头功要算在你的头上……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_08

entries.text: 聂凯作为帮手\n也表现得相当不错。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_09

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n聂凯说你们两个认识，\r\n你们打过很长时间的交道吗？[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_10

entries.text: 很长
entries.label: team_0090_select_01

entries.text: 很短
entries.label: team_0090_select_02

entries.text: 不论如何，你都有个可靠的朋友啊。\n简直就像以前的大家一样……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_11

entries.text: 以前？
entries.label: team_0090_select_03

entries.text: 大家？
entries.label: team_0090_select_04

entries.text: ……天星队是由在学校里经常被霸凌的\n孩子们组成的，这件事你知道吧？[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_12

entries.text: 在天星队组成不久之后，\n老大们和爱霸凌人的学生们\r\n展开了全面对决。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_13

entries.text: 结果，\n天星队大获全胜……\r\n不，甚至那都算不上对决。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_14

entries.text: ……因为爱霸凌人的学生们\n都放弃了战斗。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_15

entries.text: 害怕天星队的他们\n一个接一个地退学了……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_16

entries.text: 这也导致队员们给周围\n留下了不好的印象。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_17

entries.text: ……我好像说了多余的话啊。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_19

entries.text: 说好的报酬。\n我把ＬＰ充到\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]的手机里吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_20

entries.text: 能用招式学习器机制作的\n招式学习器的种类增加了！
entries.label: team_0090_system_03

entries.text: 灵活运用招式学习器吧。\n剩下的老大也交给你了。\r\n……追加报酬去找补给班的人领取吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_18

entries.text: 那、那个，我已经来了……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_01

entries.text: 啊嘎嘶！
entries.label: team_0090_legend_01

entries.text: 呜啊啊！\n你不要出来！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_02

entries.text: ……哦～天星队原来\n还有那样的过去啊。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_04

entries.text: 本来是想消灭霸凌，\n结果现在他们自己却变得人见人怕……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_05

entries.text: 太搞笑了。\n老师和学生也都是笨蛋。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_06

entries.text: 当大家正在被霸凌的时候，\n哪怕有一个外人能注意到这一点……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_07

entries.text: 那很快就应该能明白\n天星队并不坏……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_08

entries.text: 在这样都是笨蛋的学校里，\n即使去战斗，\r\n也只有自己吃亏的份……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_09

entries.text: 创建天星队的\n那个叫真老大的也一定\r\n是个无可救药的傻瓜。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_10

entries.text: 没那回事
entries.label: team_0090_select_05

entries.text: 是吗？
entries.label: team_0090_select_06

entries.text: 嗯，这次的报酬。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_12
